chapter_title: Concerning the Five Releases: what they are
chapter_note: This chapter is largely a systematic, numbered cosmological exposition of five "releases" (redemptive extractions of Light) tied to major cosmic agents (First Man, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Splendour, Great Counsel/Summons-and-Obedience). Later hands appear mainly as (a) brief dialogue/frame attribution at the start, (b) a Christian/institutional inflection inside the Jesus-the-Splendour section ("churches", possible Phil 2 allusion to "form of flesh"), (c) an apostolic/commandment institutionalization in the eschatological paragraph, and (d) a concluding beatitude-style exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.60⟩
[There are] five [releases by] which the Light is saved f[rom] all [the rulers and] powers of Darkness!
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the hagiographic/dialogue attribution "[Once again] our father [s]peaks" as later FRAME wrapping the teaching statement.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The content is a bare, impersonal thesis introducing a numbered cosmological set (old teaching style), but it is introduced by a formulaic speaker-attribution typical of the later compiled dialogue frame.

paragraphs.core_text: [The first loo]sening and saving is that of [the] First Man, since when the First M[a]n was freed fro[m the prison of] the rulers by the Living Spirit, who had come [... ...] of the First Man, much Light and [much] power was saved from the entire ruling-power. They ascended with the First Man to the aeons [of] greatn[ess]. This [is the first] release.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic first item in a numbered soteriological mechanism; entirely cosmos→cosmos (entities, prison, ascent to aeons), with impersonal explanatory voice.

paragraphs.core_text: The second saving is that of the Liv[ing] Spirit, since whe[n] the Father of Life and [the] Mother of [Li]fe constructed [the ... ...] and [w]orlds [... wo]rlds, the earths and their [rulers; im]measurable Light was saved f[r]om them [... the First] Man, who w[a]s devoured [...] lig[ht ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the numbered cosmological sequence (second saving) with purely internal cosmological actors and world-construction language; no citation or exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.61⟩
... ... th]ree wars [... ...] to the time when he [... ...] above [...] them upon the [... ...] universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Highly lacunose but still framed as cosmic process/chronology (wars, elevation "above" them, universe). Classified core with uncertainty due to fragmentary state.

paragraphs.core_text: [The third red]emption is that of the Thi[rd Ambassador ... he] displayed [his image ...] he [... ... the r]uling-power; he [... ... ... ...] from them [... ...] So this is [how] the [...] his image that [...] in the Th[ir]d Ambassador.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third item in the numbered list, using classic Manichaean cosmological machinery (Third Ambassador, image-display as redemptive technique), staying within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: [Th]e fourth s[av]ing is that of Jesus the Splendour, since whe[n he was] re[ve]aled in the zone he displayed [his im]age in front of the firmaments and purified [the Light] that is above. He set in order [t]he earths and all the fastenings. He also loosen[ed ...] Light without measure in the entire structure. He gave [the] summons and the obedience to the elements, he formed [J]esus the Youth. He as[ce]n[d]ed and rested himself in the Light [land].
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the institutional/Christianizing insertions that reach outside the closed cosmic mechanism: "He established the first righteous o[ne ...] all the churches" and the incarnation-like phrasing "... un[til] he travelled and descended to the form of flesh" (likely the vector for the Phil. 2 footnote).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Base layer is cosmic exposition of Jesus the Splendour as a defined redemptive agent (zone/firmaments/elements/Light-land). The sudden reference to "churches" and the "form of flesh" descent reads as later overlay/application that points beyond cosmos→cosmos description and aligns with NT/Pauline imagery noted in the apparatus (Phil 2).

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth release and saving is that of the great counsel, w[hich is the s]umm[ons an]d the obedience, since it also [...] the soul from the [land] of greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Final item in the fivefold system; defines a cosmic function (Great Counsel = Summons/Obedience) operating on the soul in relation to the Land of Greatness—still internal, impersonal mechanism.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.62⟩
[...] the Living Spirit [...] as he gave [...] the release [... ...]
The first [... ... he] ascended and he [... ...] as he [... ...] wisdom [... ...]
The fourth [... ...] its wisdom [...]
And also, the fifth [... ...] into it, and it sets it in order [...] its Light image in this Last Statue.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fragmentary recap/coordination of the releases with functional predicates (ascent, wisdom, ordering) and the Last Statue—still a closed cosmological register.

paragraphs.core_text: These five grea[t] powe[rs ...] were revealed. They came to a profit [... ...] they were established upon [... ...] First Man [...] when he came to/ward [...] from the struggle. He set in order and constructed [...] universe [... ...] the First M[an ...] his advent.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Despite an elevated application-voice score, the extant wording remains cosmic-historical (revelation of powers, First Man, struggle, construction/order of the universe) with no explicit audience address or institutional target.
Too short/lacunose for strong diagnostics; treated as core connective within the ongoing cosmological exposition (no institutional anchoring present).

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.63⟩
... because of the Light [th]at had rushed from [... ...] the Amba[s]sa[d]or.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic causation language centered on Light and the (Third) Ambassador; no frame/citation/exhortation markers.

paragraphs.core_text: The counse[l] of life, which is the [s]ummons and the obedience, will make [... ...] In this last season they [... the] life of the S[t]at[ue and] he judges the sou[ls ... he] can send [... ...] powers, they [...] from the [... ...] it is alive [...] of the will [of the ...] Father, the establ[ished one ...] powerful; they g[o ...] enemy, they [...] all of them [...] conquer this land that they have [... ...] in it for ever [... ... t]hey came fr[om h]im in the beginning, as t[hey will r]eturn again to the Light. They [as]cend to him at the la[st].
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the institutional/apostolic graft: "seal the commandment and the [...] of all [the] apostles" ("apostles" and "commandment" function as later community/institutional legitimation rather than cosmological mechanism).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core layer is eschatological mechanics (Counsel/Summons-Obedience, Last season, Statue judging souls, return/ascent to Light) within the cosmic system. The explicit appeal to "apostles" and "commandment" is a later institutionalization signal.
Beatitude-style exhortation addressed to "every person" who understands; shifts from describing cosmic structures to moral/audience-facing encouragement—typical pastoral/application closure.
